items.title: Joseph Thomas Interview, 1960-09-29
items.q: I was with Papa you know when we went to Washington and played for a command performance with President Eisenhower.

ctx.x: Uh let me see. Original Tuxedo. Original Tuxedo. Yes. Yeah. I'd say about 12 or 13 years now. Oh yeah. We don't know that much. I remember that. Uh I was with Papa you know when we went to Washington and played for a command performance with President Eisenhower. Yeah. Yeah. At the Statler Hotel. And then I was with him when we made the picture center around the holiday. Yeah.
Was that in the Absinthe House?
